name: 相位一致性
description: 检测 edges and 特征 using phase congruency in the 频域. This 光照-invariant method reveals structural differences in AI content.
mechanism: 分析 phase alignment 跨 multiple frequency scales. Phase congruency highlights structural 特征 invariant to 光照.
parameters: Scales: 4, Orientations: 6, Noise 阈值: 自适应
source: Morrone and Owens (1987), Pattern Recognition Letters
useCase: Detecting structural 异常 in AI生成的 images

references.title: Kovesi, P. (2000). Phase Congruency: A Low-Level Image Invariant. Psychological Research.
Morrone, M.C. & Owens, R.A. (1987). Feature Detection from Local Energy. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Kovesi, P. (1999). Image Features from Phase Congruency. Journal of Computer Vision Research.

strengths:
• Contrast-invariant edge and 特征 检测
• Based on local energy model of 特征 perception
• 检测 edges regardless of 光照 changes
• Provides both edge strength and orientation
• Mathematically elegant frequency-domain approach
limitations:
• 计算成本高 due to multiple filter responses
• Sensitive to noise in low-对比度 regions
• Parameter tuning required for optimal results
• May miss texture-based 异常
• Resolution-dependent performance
